data.name: Arizah
data.gender_notes: Arizah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'arizah', meaning gentle, delicate, or soft. In Islamic history, Arizah represents a gentle and compassionate soul, cherished for her calm demeanor and kind heart. The name Arizah carries the meaning “Gentle, delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arizah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes tranquility and compassion in the soul.
data.etymology: Arizah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arizah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: عَرِزَة
in_urdu.meaning: وہ مہربانی والی خاتون جو خوبصورتی کے اعزاز کے لئے پیدا ہوئی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عَرِزَة: علم و عزت کے اعزاز کا نام ہے، جو خوبصورتی کا اعزاز حاصل کرتے ہوئے اپنے وقت کے سب سے اچھے لوگوں میں شمار ہوتی ہے، اور اسی طرح کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو خواتین کے لیے مخصوص ہیں، اور انہیں عارضی طور پر اُن کے والدین کا نام دیا جاتا ہے، اور جب وہ نوجوان ہو جاتی ہے تو اسے ان کا نام بنایا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام ان کے لیے ایک اعزاز ہے، اور انہیں اس نام سے پکارا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.long_meaning: अरिज़ा: यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है खूबसूरती और मेहनत। यह नाम एक पुराना नाम है जो मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है। इसका उल्लेख कुरान में भी मिलता है। यह नाम एक आदर्श नाम है जो एक महिला की खूबसूरती और मेहनत को दर्शाता है। यह नाम एक अच्छा विकल्प है जो आपकी बेटी को दिया जा सकता है।

in_english.name: Arizah
in_english.meaning: The girl who excels in beauty and is a woman of great beauty and virtue
in_english.long_meaning: Arizah: A name derived from Arabic roots, meaning 'excellence in beauty' and 'virtue'. It is a name that signifies the qualities of a woman who is not only physically beautiful but also possesses inner virtues and characteristics that make her stand out. In Islamic tradition, the name Arizah is associated with the qualities of a woman who is described as 'having a beautiful face and a beautiful heart'. The name is also associated with the Arabic word for 'excellence' and 'virtue', which are essential qualities for a Muslim woman. The name has been used in various cultures and languages, including Arabic, Turkish, Urdu, and Hindi.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arizah holds a special place in the cultural narrative of Morocco, amidst the Berber communities. Here, it is believed that Arizah represents the gentle and nurturing spirit of a mother or a caring friend. The name beautifully encapsulates the essence of kindness, tenderness, and support, which is deeply cherished and valued within the Moroccan culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Arizah serves as a reminder of the quiet and gentle strength found within water. Water, a revered symbol in Islam, is believed to have the power to cleanse, purify and revitalize. Likewise, a woman named Arizah is seen as a source of renewal and rejuvenation, with a gentle touch that touches the soul and reminds us of the mercy and kindness of Allah. Her spirit is likened to the gentle ripples of water, which calm the mind and nourish the soul, allowing one to connect more deeply with the divine.
